headline: Record CV volumes drive strong Q2FY27 performance

highlights: Daily Volume 1,49,99,057 Q2FY27: Revenue & EBITDA ahead of estimate; PAT misses estimate ▪ Revenue was up 39.4% YoY and 38.7% QoQ to INR 1,33,643 Mn (vs CIE est. of INR 1,27,522 Mn).
This was driven by a 31.7% YoY volume increase and a 5.8% YoY ASP increase. ▪ EBITDA was up 16.2% YoY and 39.2% QoQ to INR 13,500 Mn (vs CIE est. of INR 13,390 Mn).
EBITDA margin was down 202 bps YoY and up 4 bps QoQ to 10.1% (vs CIE est. of 10.5%). ▪ APAT was up 12.7% YoY and 42.7% QoQ to INR 8,690 Mn (vs CIE est. of INR 9,029 Mn).
EBITDA grew 16.2%, supported by higher volumes, operating leverage, improved price realisation and favourable product mix, partly offsetting commodity inflation.
valuation: Price realisation is targeted to improve 100– 150 bps in Q3FY27E, while the medium-term mid-teens margin target remains the same.

View and Valuation: We lower our FY27/28E EPS estimate by 2.5/1.5%, respectively, factoring in sustained commodity inflation and near-term margin pressures, partly offset by a strong volume growth and improved price realisation.

We value AL’s core business at 21x (maintained) the average of FY28/29E EPS, while assigning INR 13/share to Hinduja Leyland Finance and INR 5/share to Switch Mobility, arriving at a target price of INR 195 (maintained).
watch: Demand outlook remains strong, while margins warrant caution: The management expects double-digit, potentially mid-teens, FY27 MHCV growth, with LCV growth remaining strong.
However, elevated commodity cost and West Asia-related export disruptions remain near-term risks to margin recovery.
